title: Resolve all code-level issues from ZOD Schema Audit Report
body:
Addresses all P0/P1/P2 code-quality issues identified in the ZOD_SCHEMA_AUDIT_REPORT.md audit. Many items were already resolved in prior work; this PR closes the remaining gaps and updates the report to reflect current state.

### Type Safety
- **`SharingRuleSchema`**: Remove `z.ZodType<any>` cast — now properly inferred from `z.discriminatedUnion()`
- **`api/metadata.zod.ts`**: Add missing `z.infer` exports (`ObjectDefinitionResponse`, `AppDefinitionResponse`, `ConceptListResponse`)

### Deprecated Export Cleanup
- **`integration/connector.zod.ts`**: Remove deprecated `AuthenticationSchema` and `FieldTransformSchema` re-exports; internal usage updated to canonical `ConnectorAuthConfigSchema`

### Documentation & Annotations
- **`qa/testing.zod.ts`**: `.describe()` coverage increased from 9 → 32 annotations
- **DependencyConflict schemas**: Cross-reference JSDoc between `hub/plugin-security.zod.ts` and `kernel/plugin-versioning.zod.ts`

### Audit Report Update
- Metrics refreshed: `z.any()` 397→9, `z.unknown()` 8→350, `.describe()` 5,026→5,691, missing `z.infer` files 5→0
- All P0/P1/P2 recommendations marked resolved; quality grade B+ → A-

```typescript
// Before: loses type info
export const SharingRuleSchema: z.ZodType<any> = z.discriminatedUnion('type', [...]);

// After: proper inference
export const SharingRuleSchema = z.discriminatedUnion('type', [...]);
```

All 3,074 tests pass across 97 test files.
